items.one_liner: CVE-2026-93582 is a CVSS 9.4 critical auth bypass in legacy OTRS Community Edition allowing complete user impersonation via crafted headers.
items.summary: A critical vulnerability, CVE-2026-93582 with a CVSS score of 9.4, affects the HTTP Basic Authentication modules in ((OTRS)) Community Edition version 6 and prior. The flaw stems from the application accepting authenticated usernames from either the `REMOTE_USER` or `HTTP_REMOTE_USER` environment variables without secondary password verification in CGI and mod_perl deployments. An unauthenticated remote attacker can supply a crafted `Remote-User` request header to impersonate any existing agent or customer user through the Generic Interface, granting unauthorized access to confidential information and system configurations. Upgrading or migrating away from affected legacy OTRS editions is required, as version 7 and later utilize Mojolicious/Hypnotoad and are unaffected.
key_facts: Affected Software: ((OTRS)) Community Edition 6.x and prior
Vector: Forged HTTP_REMOTE_USER header via Basic Auth module
items.bottom_line: Legacy ((OTRS)) Community Edition 6 and earlier contain a critical 9.4-rated authentication bypass allowing complete user impersonation via forged HTTP headers.

items.title: Mapping of two Western Ghats districts shows much of proposed ESA overlaps with Notified Forests, Protected Areas, or existing ESZs
items.one_liner: Spatial analysis suggests the proposed Western Ghats ESA largely formalizes existing protections, potentially easing concerns about new land-use restrictions in Karnataka.
items.summary: The Paani Earth Foundation analyzed the Centre’s draft notification for an Ecologically Sensitive Area (ESA) in the Western Ghats, specifically focusing on Kodagu and Udupi districts. The mapping reveals that a significant majority of the proposed ESA—70.8% in Kodagu and 82% in Udupi—already overlaps with existing protected areas like Notified Forests or Eco-Sensitive Zones. This analysis highlights that the proposed ESA designation primarily reinforces existing protections rather than imposing entirely new restrictions on the remaining 18-30% of land. The findings emerge amid ongoing political tension, as the Karnataka legislature recently passed a resolution rejecting the K. Kasturirangan Committee report in its current form.
items.bottom_line: The proposed ESA for the Western Ghats is largely redundant with existing legal protections, suggesting that fears of widespread new land-use restrictions may be overstated.

items.title: BiShield-TEE: On the (In-)Security of Unilateral Weight Obfuscation in On-Device TEE-Shielded LLM Partition
items.one_liner: Unilateral weight obfuscation in TEE-shielded LLMs is vulnerable to structural recovery, prompting a bilateral defense framework.
items.summary: On-device deployments of large language models rely on Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for hardware-enforced isolation, but typical unilateral matrix transformations leave weight obfuscation vulnerable to reverse engineering. Researchers identified the Solution Determinacy Property (SDP), a vulnerability where unilateral obfuscation secrets are uniquely determined, allowing attackers to reconstruct proprietary model weights. Evaluating representative frameworks like GroupCover and ArrowCloak under this attack strategy showed protection reduced to negligible levels. To resolve this, researchers introduced BiShield-TEE, a bilateral framework that joints input and output dimension obfuscation to induce ambiguous solutions, effectively protecting model weights while maintaining high inference efficiency.
items.bottom_line: Standard unilateral weight obfuscation in on-device TEE models fails against determinacy attacks, requiring bilateral joint transformations to secure intellectual property.

items.title: AutoOnboarder: Autonomously Onboarding LLM Agents
items.one_liner: AutoOnboarder automatically tunes LLM agents and harnesses to match frontier baselines at significantly lower costs.
items.summary: Agentic large language models often experience a drop in reasoning capabilities when placed inside standard software harnesses. To address this, researchers have introduced AutoOnboarder, an autonomous system that uses an intelligent onboarding coding agent to tailor foundation models, prompts, and harness code. Acting similarly to an employee trainer, the Onboarder operates with only tens of examples while keeping evaluation data isolated on a separate virtual machine. Tests on genomic-sequencing prior authorization tasks show that these autonomously onboarded agents match or exceed Gemini 3.5 Flash baselines at up to 29 times lower costs.
key_facts: Cost reduction: up to 29x lower costs
items.bottom_line: AutoOnboarder uses an autonomous coding agent to optimize LLM harness source code and prompts, matching baseline performance at a fraction of the cost.
